source_snapshot.procedure: Connect the NIC under test to a separate physical peer, configure same-subnet addressing, prove continuous ping, physically remove the link and observe failure, reconnect it and prove network recovery.
source_snapshot.criteria: Connection or network activity recovers after a lost or failed link.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL read-only ip link/ethtool and filtered dmesg over unsafe SSH, with the physical disconnect assigned to an operator.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED with HIGH risk; operator handles the cable while the agent runs bounded ping/carrier monitoring on an isolated non-management port with OOB recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes manual link disturbance but does not define the exact port/peer, capture the down interval, bound ping, preserve complete logs or protect remote access.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves the separate physical peer and link-loss/recovery sequence while adding bounded monitoring, explicit isolation, recovery timing and OOB safeguards.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Administrative port down/up and NIC driver cases do not replace the required physical carrier loss and reconnection evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Manual cable handling and user-approved topology make this RPUC even though evidence collection is automatable.

original_test_intent: Demonstrate that an approved NIC link loses carrier and traffic when its cable is removed and autonomously returns to the expected negotiated state and peer connectivity after the same cable is restored.
original_method: A qualified operator disconnects and reconnects the identified cable while the agent records bounded peer traffic, carrier, negotiated link, counters, timestamps and system health before, during and after the event.
manual_activity: User approves the isolated topology and timeout; qualified operator removes and restores the exact test cable; agent monitors and records evidence.
required_inputs: Exact DUT NIC/PCI/netdev/physical-port and cable mapping
Separate physical peer, same-subnet IP plan and expected speed/duplex/autoneg
Bounded ping or health probe interval/count and acceptable carrier/traffic recovery timeout
Confirmation that the path is not management, BMC, storage, cluster or production critical
Independent OOB/console, operator, recovery procedure and protected evidence location
safety_requirements: Prove test-port isolation and independent recovery access before touching the cable
Use a bounded probe and stop deadline rather than ping -t or an unbounded Linux ping
Stop on wrong-port indication, unexpected route/service impact, loss of management, peer instability or failure to recover
Preserve complete baseline/down/up/post logs; do not clear logs or automatically retry the disturbance
Restore and verify the same cable, negotiated link and routing at completion
agent_execution_scope: Collect baseline mapping, carrier, counters, routes, peer reachability and health
Run bounded traffic and timestamp carrier/link transitions while the operator handles the cable
Compare restored speed/duplex, counters, routes and peer connectivity with baseline
Do not select or physically manipulate a port, disconnect management, retry automatically or issue the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the exact isolated topology, timeout and acceptable recovery behavior
Provide operator and independent recovery coverage
Review timing, link, traffic and health evidence and issue the verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only a partial post-state inspection; it cannot prove the required before-success, physical link-down/ping-failure and bounded post-reconnect recovery sequence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved secure sessions to run a bounded peer probe plus timestamped platform-native carrier/link/counter monitoring for the named interface; capture complete logs before, during and after operator disconnect/reconnect.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Separate physical server, same subnet, successful ping, failed ping on link removal, successful ping after reconnection and 5/5 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind monitoring to the explicitly mapped test port and peer, establish baseline success, capture a real carrier-down/traffic-failure interval, then measure carrier and traffic restoration against an approved deadline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Bounds the probe, timestamps transitions, protects management reachability and requires complete state comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation assists observation but does not replace the physical disconnect/reconnect or engineer verdict.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Autonegotiation, spanning tree, bonds, VLANs or peer behavior may delay traffic after carrier recovery; the approved topology and timeout must account for them.

project_override_considerations: Project wiring, failover, bonding, VLAN and management-path policy may narrow the eligible test port; no port is inferred from interface enumeration order.
expected_evidence: Approval and DUT/peer/port/cable/IP map with isolation proof
Host/NIC/driver/firmware, route, link, speed/duplex, counters and peer baseline
Timestamped bounded probe success, carrier-down and traffic-failure evidence
Operator disconnect/reconnect timestamps and exact cable identity
Carrier-up, negotiated state and bounded traffic recovery time
Complete network/system/SEL health logs, final topology and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 agree that physical link loss is manual and network recovery is the objective; GPT V2 correctly supplies missing safety and evidence controls.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is executable after project supplies the isolated port, peer, operator, timeout and OOB recovery; those are run-time prerequisites, not an inherent static-review block.

review_improvement: Turns an unsafe post-state snapshot into a traceable physical link-loss and bounded recovery measurement without sacrificing the original ping-fail/ping-recover sequence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A recovered administrative interface state is insufficient: the test requires proof of a real physical carrier transition and traffic interruption, followed by negotiated-link and end-to-end reachability recovery on the same path. Because cable removal can strand the control session, interface identity and independent access must be established before the disturbance.
